mcqs.question: Which of the following statements about the reactivity series reflects a common misconception?

options.A: A metal higher in the reactivity series can displace a metal lower in the series from its salt solution.
options.B: All metals in the reactivity series are equally reactive.
options.C: Metals below hydrogen in the series do not react with dilute acids.
options.D: Gold is placed below hydrogen in the reactivity series.

mcqs.answer: All metals in the reactivity series are equally reactive.
mcqs.explanation: The reactivity series ranks metals from most to least reactive; they are not equally reactive. Option B is therefore a misconception. Options A, C and D are correct statements about the series.

mcqs.question: A strip of zinc metal is placed in an aqueous solution of copper(II) sulfate. Which of the following best describes what happens?

options.B: Zinc displaces copper, forming zinc sulfate and metallic copper.
options.C: Copper displaces zinc, forming copper metal and zinc sulfate.
options.D: Both metals dissolve partially, producing a mixed solution without any solid deposit.

mcqs.answer: Zinc displaces copper, forming zinc sulfate and metallic copper.
mcqs.explanation: Zinc is higher than copper in the reactivity series, so it can displace copper from its salt solution, producing ZnSO₄ and copper metal. Options A, C and D contradict the reactivity series predictions.

mcqs.learning_point: Understand reactions of metals with salt solutions
mcqs.question: When iron metal and copper metal are separately added to separate solutions of silver nitrate, which observation is correct?

options.A: Both iron and copper deposit metallic silver.
options.B: Only iron deposits metallic silver; copper shows no reaction.
options.C: Only copper deposits metallic silver; iron shows no reaction.

mcqs.answer: Only iron deposits metallic silver; copper shows no reaction.
mcqs.explanation: Iron is above silver in the reactivity series and can displace silver ions, forming Fe(NO₃)₂ and silver metal. Copper is below silver, so it cannot displace silver ions, resulting in no reaction. Hence option B is correct.

mcqs.question: Which of the following metals is the most reactive according to the standard reactivity series?
mcqs.explanation: In the reactivity series, magnesium (Mg) lies above zinc, iron and copper, making it the most reactive among the listed metals. Therefore, option A is the correct choice.

mcqs.question: Which of the following lists the metals in order of decreasing reactivity?

options.A: K > Ca > Na > Mg > Al > Zn > Fe > Sn > Pb > H > Cu > Ag > Au
options.B: Na > K > Ca > Mg > Al > Zn > Fe > Sn > Pb > H > Cu > Ag > Au
options.C: K > Na > Ca > Mg > Al > Zn > Fe > Sn > Pb > H > Cu > Ag > Au
options.D: K > Ca > Na > Mg > Al > Zn > Fe > Sn > Pb > H > Ag > Cu > Au

mcqs.answer: K > Na > Ca > Mg > Al > Zn > Fe > Sn > Pb > H > Cu > Ag > Au
mcqs.explanation: The standard reactivity series from most to least reactive is: K, Na, Ca, Mg, Al, Zn, Fe, Sn, Pb, (H), Cu, Ag, Au. Option C matches this order exactly.

mcqs.question: When a piece of magnesium metal is placed in a solution of copper(II) sulfate, which reaction will definitely occur?

options.D: Both metals dissolve partially, forming a mixed solution without any solid deposit.

mcqs.explanation: Magnesium is higher than copper in the reactivity series, so it displaces copper from copper sulfate, producing magnesium sulfate and metallic copper. Options A, C and D contradict this prediction.

mcqs.learning_point: Understand reactions of metals with salt solutions
mcqs.question: Which statement correctly distinguishes a displacement reaction from a non‑displacement reaction in the context of the reactivity series?

options.A: In a displacement reaction, a more reactive metal replaces a less reactive metal from its compound.
options.B: In a displacement reaction, a less reactive metal replaces a more reactive metal from its compound.
options.C: Displacement reactions occur only when acids are present.
options.D: Displacement reactions always produce a gaseous product.

mcqs.answer: In a displacement reaction, a more reactive metal replaces a less reactive metal from its compound.
mcqs.explanation: A displacement (or single‑replacement) reaction happens when a metal higher in the reactivity series displaces a metal lower in the series from its salt or solution. Options B, C and D are incorrect descriptions.

mcqs.question: A student wants to extract copper metal from its ore using a more reactive metal. Which metal should be used for this purpose?
mcqs.explanation: Zinc is higher than copper in the reactivity series, so it can displace copper ions from copper compounds, allowing extraction of copper metal. Silver and gold are less reactive, and lead is also less reactive than copper, so they would not work.
